Dear Colleagues,
Ms. Tanja raised a ticket regarding a BC2 which has a communication error to the KF11. Please check the following lines:
First step is to remove and reattach XD10.3, this connector is loose sometimes and can cause the connection drop.
Second step is to check the input to KF11 and BC2 as shown above.
Third step, if the steps above check out and the error is still persisting, please replace the Bender.
